task: Bounded independent design/source scout for a fresh AI-infrastructure documentation claim-verification benchmark before any model output. Prior public QA test got8/12: two overlong but factual spans and two failed abstentions. Proposed task: given a version-pinned supplied documentation packet and operational claim, return supported/contradicted/insufficient plus evidence IDs. We want realistic informational assistance, not autonomous cluster actions. Identify6 freely accessible primary-source documentation sections with permissive redistributable source/licenses (GPU scheduling, memory accounting, prefix caching, resource sharing, sleep/power, serving). Suggest3 nontrivial clear claims per source (one of each verdict) with evidence and explicit scope; for insufficient use genuinely absent information rather than intent-vs-outcome ambiguities. Also name the strongest cheap alternative/workflow and identify claims we must not make. Favor Kubernetes, PyTorch, vLLM, Ray, Slurm originals; no paid resources. Do not inspect or call local models, edit canonical project files, or propose changing prior frozen scores. Keep scope bounded and return primary URLs/license evidence; mark any unverified fact.
criteria: Six source-backed sections and18 candidate claim/verdict/rationale triples; explicit missing information for insufficient; no training/operational execution; distinguish authored qualification fixture from measured economic evidence; usable source licenses or mark unavailable; no unsupported novelty or efficiency claims.
